descriptions.notStarted: I keep hearing the groans and bellows of machinery echoing through the house.  What is making this racket?  Is it where these infernal toys are coming from?
descriptions.inProgress: I found Jonas Prendergast in his Toy Workshop at the top of the house, in front of a huge toy machine which seems to be the source of all these infernal toys!  It seems that his machine is not functioning properly.  If I collect #b50 Firewood#k, #b25 Screws#k, and #b25 Loaded Springs#k, Jonas can build the replacement part to get his machine working properly again.  I know that the Rocking Horses will have the #bFirewood#k and the Psycho Jacks will have the #bScrews and Loaded Springs#k.  I've got to get what Jonas needs-perhaps this will stop it from churning out all these crazy toys!
descriptions.completed: I collected the parts Jonas needed to fix his machine.  I hope I haven't simply helped a madman create more of his messed up toys.
